name: section-label
description: Shared section-label primitive. customJS.SectionLabel.render(dv, { text, top? }) renders a small uppercase muted label + hairline divider above — the canonical replacement for ## H2 section headings across every blueprint. Promoted verbatim from the project blueprint helper (sauce v0.109.0 S2) into a mechanism at v0.122.0 so non-project blueprints no longer depend on the project blueprint for it. Class name unchanged (SectionLabel) — existing dv.view + customJS.SectionLabel.render callers keep working.
